about: One coordinate on a scale of a hundred and five levels carries the whole quantum story in four fields of a line.
Superposed it holds six point seven bits; two claims that meet at one level make it definite; a ceiling under that floor makes it forbidden, not narrow.
And a second coordinate resting on the bound that moved narrows to five point four bits without anyone measuring it.
Preparation and measurement on one coordinate of two hundred and fifty-six levels: free at eight bits, and five bits once two claims in phase leave it between a hundred and a hundred and thirty-one.
Asking for the wide ceiling again leaves it where the narrow one put it. That is what irreversible means here, and it is the same fact as a signature being a meet.
